title: Towards Massive Multilingual Holistic Bias
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measures gender bias (robustness and overgeneralization) and added toxicity in machine translation tasks for sentences containing descriptors related to religion and other demographic axes.
findings: In English-to-other-language machine translation, the 'religion' demographic axis exhibited the highest degree of gender overgeneralization towards masculine forms, with a chrF score difference of 15.30 between masculine and feminine references.
